# CI/CD Workflows

GitHub Actions workflows for continuous integration and deployment of OpenWorld VPN.

Planned workflows (to be implemented in a future step):
- `backend-ci.yml` — Lint, build, and test the backend service.
- `mobile-ci.yml` — Analyze, build, and test the Flutter mobile app.
- `admin-ci.yml` — Lint, build, and test the admin dashboard.
